evidenceBoundary: The built single-file Pull Requests app runs in Chromium with a deterministic local window.ryu bridge. Tests prove local clipboard contents, UI fallback, merge-queue request payload and local submission notice only; they do not authenticate with GitHub, invoke the real gh CLI, or prove a GitHub merge queue accepted or completed the request.

assertions.testTitle: copying a one-time GitHub code writes the exact code to the local clipboard
assertions.assertionName: Copy reports success only after the local clipboard contains the presented device code.

assertions.testTitle: Queue stack submits the exact merge-queue request and shows local submission feedback
assertions.assertionName: The stack menu sends squash plus merge_queue with auto enabled and renders the local submission status.
